name: Tidal Commerce

google.heading: Tidal Commerce on Google
google.summary: No rating is published here because there is not enough behind it to publish. The Oak Brook listing carries five reviews and the newest is two years old. Four are positive and describe what a good ISO relationship looks like: a savings estimate before signing, an account set up by a named person, and processing that then ran without anyone thinking about it. The one negative review, from eight years ago, describes the opposite and the specific complaint is calls not being returned. Five accounts spread over eight years cannot establish a pattern in either direction, and averaging them into a 4.4 would give five opinions the weight of a score. What the reviews do confirm is the shape of the business: merchants dealing with individuals at a small Chicago-area ISO rather than with a support queue.
